questions.question: Why log JSON fields instead of a sentence like "Lantern Lane Bakery needs review"?
options: Tools can filter and count by field without parsing text.
questions.explanation: Structured fields make questions like "how many no_website reasons last night?" a simple filter.

questions.question: Why does the alert wait for at least 20 results?
options: Because the classifier needs warming up
So a few unlucky companies at the start do not raise a false alarm
questions.explanation: Small samples are noisy. Alerts that fire on noise get ignored, which defeats them.

questions.question: Which field should NOT go into the enrichment log event?
questions.explanation: Logs are copied widely and kept long. Log identifiers and outcomes; keep page content in the store, where access is controlled.
